title: Backend patch does not enforce RFC 8620 §5.3 existing-parent rule
description: RFC 8620 §5.3: all pointer parts before the last MUST already exist, else invalidPatch. Generic backend apply_jmap_patch (crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs and likely shared patch code) does not reject a pointer into an absent/non-object own-type property. Found during JMAP-4vf8.18.
